map.劳动力（就业+失业），不含不在劳动力者，故参与率影响解读。结果仅作经济学教学与快: The labour force (employed + unemployed), excluding those not in the labour force, so the participation rate affects interpretation. map.不含摩擦性失业的最低可持续失业率，约 4–5%，高于此或示需求不足。结果仅作经济: The lowest sustainable unemployment rate excluding frictional unemployment, about 4–5%; above that may signal insufficient demand. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimates only, not investment advice or policy basis; defer to authoritative statistics and textbooks.
map.常用 U3 为狭义失业，U6 含准失业与边际劳动力，口径更广。结果仅作经济学教学: U3, commonly used, is the narrow definition; U6 includes discouraged workers and marginally attached labour, a broader measure. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimates only, not investment advice or policy basis; defer to authoritative statistics and textbooks.
